The *Duṭṭhaṭṭhakasuttaniddesa* ("Exposition of the Eight on Corruptions", Mnd 3) is the third expository section of the *Mahāniddesa*, serving as an early canonical commentary on the *Duṭṭhaṭṭhaka Sutta* (Snp 4.3) found in the *Aṭṭhakavagga* of the *Sutta Nipāta* [SuttaCentral]. The text provides verse-by-verse and word-by-word glosses in standard Niddesa exegetical style, and SuttaCentral indexes two modern translations across two languages [SuttaCentral].

Curated passage-level parallels identified by SuttaCentral include the *Khaggavisāṇasuttaniddesa* (Cnd 23) in the *Cullaniddesa* and the *Khuddakavatthuvibhaṅga* (Vb 17) of the Abhidhamma Vibhaṅga, alongside resembling parallels in the *Dhammasaṅgaṇī* (*Dukanikkhepa*, Ds 2.3.2), *Pārāyanānugītigāthāniddesa* (Cnd 22), *Puṇṇakamāṇavapucchāniddesa* (Cnd 7), and *Attadaṇḍasuttaniddesa* (Mnd 15) [SuttaCentral]. Related topics or citations connect it to discourses such as the *Kīṭāgiri Sutta* (MN 70), *Dutiyadasabalasutta* (SN 12.22), and *Sabhiya Sutta* (Snp 3.6) [SuttaCentral].

Automated analysis by DharmaNexus reflects dense Pali-internal text reuse, detecting 4,132 matching segments across 151 Pali texts [DharmaNexus]. Textual material is heavily shared with adjacent Niddesa tractates—most notably the *Purābhedasuttaniddesa* (Mnd 10), *Mahābyūhasuttaniddesa* (Mnd 13), *Tuvaṭakasuttaniddesa* (Mnd 14), and *Paramaṭṭhakasuttaniddesa* (Mnd 5)—as well as the *Khuddakavatthuvibhaṅga* (Vb 17, where DharmaNexus and SuttaCentral concur), the *Dasakanipāta* of the *Aṅguttara Nikāya* (AN 10), and the commentary *Mahāniddesa-aṭṭhakathā* [DharmaNexus]. DharmaNexus also aligns segments of this text with non-Pali corpora, generating matches with Sanskrit scholastic works including Nāgārjuna's *Dharmasaṃgraha*, Candrakīrti's *Prasannapadā*, the Sarvāstivāda *Dharmaskandha*, the *Śrāvakabhūmi*, and the Chinese *Bieyi Za ahan jing* (T 100) [DharmaNexus].
